title: Data on the move, at rest, in use

slides.title: Three rooms for data
slides.text: Pim sorts data into three rooms. The van is data in transit, the vault is data at rest, and the reading desk is data in use, open while you work with it.
slides.alt: The whole journey of a picture in five rule cards, waiting to be put in the right order.

focus.cue: A picture's journey, in five rule cards
Put them in the order they happen

slides.title: One photo, three rooms
slides.text: Follow one photo through the post office. Each room has its own trick, so each room needs its own lock.
steps: on the desk, in use: guard who can see it
in the van, in transit: seal the trip
in the vault, at rest: lock the storage
slides.alt: The sealed route: a message travels a road marked sealed, the padlock idea played as a journey.

focus.cue: In transit: the van on a sealed road
Each room needs its own lock

slides.title: The cloud is a borrowed vault
slides.text: The cloud is a vault in someone else's building. Backups and sharing get easy, but you trust their locks and their workers to keep your data safe.
slides.alt: The backup rule in four steps: make a second copy, keep it in another place, check it opens, keep it fresh.

focus.cue: A copy kept in another place
The line runs from Pim's Post to Grandma's House

slides.title: Photos that upload themselves
slides.text: Many devices send photos to the cloud by themselves. Choosing what belongs in which vault is a Cyber Defender decision, not a default to leave switched on.
slides.alt: Would you rather keep photos only on your own tablet, or keep a copy on a service someone else runs?

focus.cue: Or a copy on a service someone else runs

slides.title: The Magpie watches all three
slides.text: The Magpie does not care which room a secret is in. It watches the van, the vault and the desk, hunting shiny secrets, so a Defender checks every room's lock.
slides.alt: A big town map with a hop budget: the birthday plan must cross in thirteen hops or fewer.

focus.cue: The Magpie watches the roads between offices
Every room and every road needs its check

words.means: facts, pictures and messages a computer stores or sends
stored and waiting, like a letter kept in a vault
on the move between one place and another
storage on computers in another building, reached over a network

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Packet Post at Many Roads and play one run for each room: in transit, at rest and in use. Before each run, name the room and its lock.
slides.alt: Many Roads in Pro: the map counts hops, and a busy router means picking another path inside the budget.

focus.cue: Play Many Roads: name the room before each run
